It starts
with a question.

Can I purchase remotely?

Yes. The team can arrange a video presentation and guide you through the process. Please confirm signing arrangements with them.

What is the starting price?

Villas start at USD 225,000. Request the latest price list, fees and availability.

How does the payment plan work?

A flexible plan is available. Ask the MARTA team for your personalised schedule and contractual terms.

What stage is the project at?

According to the developer, the project has launched, the land is signed and architects are finalising the technical plans.

Can I rent out my villa?

The project is designed with short-stay rentals in mind. The team will explain management options, costs and applicable terms.
